headline: Continued 139 Paramount Street special permit amendment to November; slaughterhouse and zoning changes discussed.
summary: Councilors discussed a slaughterhouse business at 785 Page Boulevard, and several said they favored it. Planning staff presented zoning ordinance changes, councilors asked questions, and one wanted to continue the temporary sign amendment.
decisions: Continued the amendment to the special permit at 139 Paramount Street to the November hearings meeting because the petitioner was not present.

decision_evidence.quote: THE PETITIONER WAS NOT PRESENT SO THE MATTER WAS CONTINUED TO THE NOVEMBER HEARINGS MEETING.

decision_titles: 139 Paramount Street special permit amendment (motor vehicle sales)
plain_text:
City Council  
     
Regular Meeting 
 
~Final~ 
   
 
36 Court Street  
Springfield, MA 01103   
http://www.springfieldcityhall.com 
 
Gladys Oyola-Lopez 
 
October 26, 2026 6:30 PM City Hall - Room 200 
 
 
 
Roll Call 
COUNCILORS PEREZ AND BROWN WERE REMOTE FOR THIS MEETING. 
Moment Of Silence - Pledge Of Allegiance 
 
M.G.L. Chapter 111, Section 151 – Slaughter House Review/Consent  
 1. 785 Page Boulevard - Slaughterhouse Business 
RYAN MCCOLLUM PRESENTED THE CONTINUED DISCUSSION FROM THE LAST 
HEARINGS MEETING. 
COMMISSIONER CAULTON HARRIS SPOKE ABOUT THEIR MEETING TO ENSURE 
PUBLIC HEALTH STANDARDS ARE UPHELD.  STATED THAT HEALTH 
DEPARTMENT IS COMFORTABLE WITH WHAT THEY SEE DUE TO ALL 
PROTECTIONS ARE IN PLACE. 
COUNSELOR FENTON STATED THAT HIS NEIGHBORHOOD LOOKED INTO THE 
BUSINESS AND APPROVES.  PARKING NEEDS TO BE IMPROVED. 
KATHY BROWN FROM EAST SPRINGFIELD NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL (ESNC) 
SPOKE AND NOTED THAT THE ESNC IS IN FAVOR OF THE INITIATIVE AND THEY 
ARE IN FAVOR. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO ASKED IF THE OTHER LOCATIONS SLAUGHTER ANY 
OTHER ANIMALS. 
COUNCILOR GOVAN SPOKE AND NOTED THAT SHE IS IN FAVOR. 
 
Special Permits 
 2. 139 Paramount Street – Amend Existing Special Permit (Motor Vehicle Sales) 
THE PETITIONER WAS NOT PRESENT SO THE MATTER WAS CONTINUED TO THE 
NOVEMBER HEARINGS MEETING.
3. 1313 (a.k.a. 1315) Boston Road - Change in petitioner (Motor Vehicle Service Station) 
MICHAEL DURANT FROM NOURIA ENERGY IN WORCESTER SPOKE ON THE 
AMENDMENT FOR THE SPECIAL PERMIT. 
COUNCILOR FENTON THANKED THE PETITIONER FOR TAKING THE PROCESS 
SERIOUSLY AND IS IN FAVOR. 
COUNCILOR GOVAN STATED THAT THEY CAME IN FORNT OF THE 
NEIGHNORHOOD COUNCIL AND IS IN FAVOR. 
 4. 1469 State Street & SS State Street - Change in petitioner (Used Car Sales) 
OWNER, GERALD GLASSER INTRODUCED BOTH MOHAMMAD AND KHALID 
ALBAGHDADI AND THEY  PRESENTED THE CHANGE IN MANAGEMENT.   
COUNCILOR CLICK BRUCE WOULD LIKE THE PETITIONERS TO SHOW UP AT THE 
PINE POINT NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL NEXT MEETING. 
COUNCILOR BROWN INQUIRED ON THE LOCATIONS AND SHARED THAT HE 
PURCHASED A CAR FROM THE BOSTON ROAD LOCATION AND THE ENGINE BLEW 
UP.  ECHOED TO GO TO THE PINE POINT NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL AND 
INTRODUCE THEMSELVES. 
 
 
Zone Changes 
 5. Amending Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article #'s 2, 4, 5, 7 & 9 
DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE PLANNING DEPARTMENT, PHIL DROMEY PRESENTED 
THE AMENDMENT.  THIS IS THE 3RD TIME THAT HE HAS BEEN IN FRONT OF THE 
COUNCIL SINCE 2013.  HE OUTLINED THE ADDITIONS AND REVISIONS. 
COUNCILOR DELGADO ASKED HOW MANY DATA CENTERS ARE IN THE CITY, AD 
THERE IS JUST ONE AT THE OLD TECH.  ALSO, ASKED IF SMALLER TRAILERS ARE 
ACCEPTABLE IN DRIVEWAYS, LESS THAN 20 FEET.  AND THEY ARE.  HE ALSO 
INQUIRED ABOUT TEMPORARY SIGNAGE. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO ASKED ABOUT THE RIVERFRONT.  PHIL STATED THAT 
THERE ARE NOW DIMENSIONAL STANDARDS. 
COUNCILOR MARTIN THANKED PHIL FOR MAKING THESE CHANGES.  GIVES THE 
CITY COUNCIL THE ABILITY TO PROTECT OUR CITY. 
COUNCILOR BROWN WOULD LIKE TO CONTINUE THE TEMP SIGN AMENDMENT. 
COUNCILOR DAVILA ASKED FOR CLARIFICATION ON THE DAY CARES. THE 
OPERATOR RESIDE AT THE RESPECTIVE PROPERTY. 
COUNCILORS FENTON AND WHITIFIELD NEED MORE INFORMATION ON ALL 
CHANGES. 
COUNCILOR MARTIN AND PEREZ ALSO HAVE QUESTIONS.  
 
[MIN_SIGNATURES]
